market.question: Will Crude Oil (CL) hit (HIGH) $140 by end of June?

assessment.reasoning: WTI ~$96 currently; Brent peak this crisis ~$128. WTI hitting $140 needs ~46% upside in 2 months — would require a far worse escalation than current. EIA forecasts Brent peak ~$115 in 2Q26.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Major escalation or full Hormuz closure could spike prices
